title: pulseboard-quality-snapshot-vanguard-2026-04-26
body:
Pulseboard — biweekly quality snapshot + onboarding triage
Date range: 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-25
Prepared by: Aisha Patel (eng-applied-ml) — working draft for sprint planning

TL;DR
- Overall onboarding pass rate fell from 84% -> 78% over the period. Largest contributors: (1) hallucination increase on instruction-following promptsets, (2) structured-output schema drift for reranker-to-generator handoffs.
- New metric introduced: Semantic Consistency Index (SCI) — measures stability of factual assertions across 3 model variants. SCI dropped 6 pts for customer-facing promptset X-17.
- Top 3 promptset failures identified for immediate triage and owners assigned. Quick mitigations suggested (prompt hinting, temporary model pin, eval threshold rollback).

Key metrics (biweekly snapshot)
- onboarding pass rate (candidate evals -> human accept): 78% (down 6 pts)
- SCI (median across new onboarding suites): 84 -> 78
- Prefix cache hit (hosted workloads): 42% -> 46% (good)
- Quantization flip-rate (64->8-bit): 2.3% unchanged
- Top-1 hallucination per 1k responses: 18 -> 29 (notable)
- Average end-to-end latency for onboards: 490ms -> 512ms (within SLO)

What changed in the window
- Rolled model variant v2.3.1 to onboarding pool for open-model catalog (2026-04-15). This variant includes a new attention kernel and tighter stop-sequence handling.
- We increased default sampling temp for exploratory promptsets to 0.9 -> 1.0 (A/B test). Early data suggests higher diversity but more hallucination regressions.
- Applied ML team enabled semantic QA checks for only 12/30 promptsets (pilot) — coverage gap may explain inconsistent SCI drops.

Top failures (ranked by impact + frequency)
1) Promptset: legal-summary-smallclaims-v4 (owner: Diego Martinez)
   - Failure mode: Factual omission + incorrect statute citation (hallucination).
   - Impact: High (customer-facing summaries).
   - Observed profile: 12% of evals fail factual-check heuristics; human score drops from 4.2 -> 3.1 (scale 1-5).
   - Hypotheses: (a) Model v2.3.1 sampling + tokenization edge-case for legal terms, (b) prompt ambiguous about citation policy.
   - Quick actions: Pin older vetted variant v2.2.9 for this promptset until patch (owner Diego) — ETA 2026-04-28. Add explicit "do not invent statutes" instruction.

2) Promptset: onboarding-chatbot-support-lite (owner: Mei Chen)
   - Failure mode: Response format drift — tool-call JSON missing required keys; downstream router rejects payload.
   - Impact: Medium-high (breaks automation for support flows).
   - Observed profile: 8% of streaming responses truncated mid-JSON; KV cache interplay suspected.
   - Hypotheses: (a) Continuous batching introduced token boundary cutoffs for streaming responses, (b) new stop-seq behavior.
   - Quick actions: Lower max-batch-size for this route, add deterministic post-process validator to mask if JSON incomplete (owner Mei) — rollout 2026-04-27.

3) Promptset: product-rerank-questions-v2 (owner: Ravi Kapoor)
   - Failure mode: Ranker-to-generator inconsistency: reranker scores favor context A but generator hallucinates context B.
   - Impact: Medium (affects relevance).
   - Observed profile: Delta in top choice fidelity increases CTR loss in canary traffic (-1.3% CTR week-over-week).
   - Hypotheses: mismatched prompt templates between reranker and generator; caching mismatch for prefixes.
   - Quick actions: Align seed prompt templates, clear relevant prefix cache keys for rehearsal runs (owner Ravi) — test by 2026-04-29.

Investigation notes / evidence
- SCI dashboard: linked in artifacts. Deeper dives show that promptsets with large template variability (many optional fields) correlate strongly with SCI drops.
- Regression test harness flagged 9 new flaky eval cases after the v2.3.1 roll; 6/9 are reproducible locally with same RNG seed when using temp>=0.95.
- GitHub PR #568 contains the attention kernel fix history and a mitigation branch.

Action items (owners, priority, target dates)
- Diego: Pin v2.2.9 for legal-summary-smallclaims-v4 and create hotfix PR for prompt clarity. Priority: P0. Target: 2026-04-28. Linked ticket: ML-1423.
- Mei: Deploy streaming JSON validator shim to staging for onboarding-chatbot-support-lite; reduce max batch size to 8 for this route. Priority: P0. Target: 2026-04-27.
- Ravi: Sync reranker/generator prompt templates and run 10k synthetic replays; clear prefix cache, report CTR delta. Priority: P1. Target: 2026-04-29.
- Sana: Expand semantic QA pilot coverage from 12 -> 24 promptsets; add automated SCI alerting when weekly delta > 4 pts. Priority: P1. Target: 2026-05-03.
- Aisha: Run targeted eval sweep for temperature effects (0.7/0.9/1.0) on 5 high-risk promptsets and produce recommendations. Priority: P2. Target: 2026-05-05.

Risks and escalation
- If hallucination rate continues to rise (>35 per 1k) we should consider rollback of sampling policy across onboarding pools.
- Latency remained under SLO but if batching reduction for some routes persists we may see baseline cost increase; recommend cost delta estimate before permanent changes.

Open questions / notes to self
- How many prompt templates include mutable optional attributes (we need a quick extractor).
- Should we add a forced model pin in the console for high-risk enterprise onboards? (ask Product: @pm-core)
- Are there any dedicated customers on v2.3.1 flagged in telemetry who could be notified proactively?

Appendix: quick reproduction steps for Diego (legal-summary)
1) Checkout GH branch: inference-evals/issue-legal-summaries (PR #573).
2) Run local harness with seed=42 and temp=1.0: python run_eval.py --promptset legal-summary-smallclaims-v4 --seed 42 --temp 1.0
3) Inspect top-5 outputs for statute citations and compare to gold.

Appendix: quick reproduction steps for Mei (chatbot support)
1) Use streaming harness: scripts/stream_test.sh --route onboarding-chatbot-support-lite --batch-size 16
2) Observe stream boundaries; toggle stop-seq flag.

Notes: this doc is intentionally a working artifact — expect updates after triage sync 2026-04-26. Keep comments inline below if you pick up an action.
